nodes.label: Windows auto-update system (scripts/windows)
nodes.rationale: Merging to main reaches the user's Windows machine within 5 minutes via Task Scheduler (MeridianAutoUpdate), so no pull instructions are needed. Launches go through wscript.exe + run-hidden.vbs because powershell/cmd briefly flash a console even with -WindowStyle Hidden.

nodes.label: meridian.db (untouchable user data)
nodes.rationale: Holds real holdings, cash and price history; gitignored with no version history or automatic backup, so anything putting it at risk must be flagged, never acted on.

nodes.label: Testing discipline (verify on real interpreter)
nodes.rationale: Three real incidents (em-dash BOM parse error under PS 5.1, git stderr treated as failure, idle-restart window flash) passed sandbox checks but broke on the user's machine; hence run real pwsh, check $LASTEXITCODE, ASCII-only .ps1, Playwright for UI.

nodes.label: Working conventions (no fabricated data, sourced figures)
nodes.norm_label: working conventions (no fabricated data, sourced figures)
nodes.rationale: Missing data renders as visibly missing via NoData; every derived figure states source and freshness; AI commentary must be able to conclude nothing happened.

nodes.norm_label: risks to review (day-change fix, post /goal, 174 routes)

nodes.label: Overnight hard rules (never push, never touch real db)
nodes.norm_label: overnight hard rules (never push, never touch real db)

nodes.label: SC-1..5 per-component checks
nodes.rationale: States, provenance, themes, accessibility and tests defined once and applied to every component.

nodes.label: AI_RULES shared prompt constraints
nodes.rationale: Every AI feature may say nothing unusual happened, cite only supplied numbers, and state unavailability rather than guessing.

nodes.label: Bull/Bear signal system
nodes.rationale: Eight independent signals, thesis drafted from signal list only, no overall score because weights cannot be defended.

nodes.label: Database schema (22 tables)
nodes.rationale: Schema created with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on every boot plus defensive ALTERs; no migration framework.

nodes.label: Design principles that must not be violated
nodes.norm_label: design principles that must not be violated

nodes.label: ensureHistory on-demand sync
nodes.rationale: Single choke-point so any page reading stored bars triggers a persisted fetch if under 30 bars; removes manual sync step.

nodes.label: node:sqlite instead of better-sqlite3
nodes.rationale: No native compilation step, nothing to fail building on Windows.

nodes.label: Precedents engine
nodes.rationale: Nearest-neighbour matching of today's technical state in the symbol's own history; refuses under about 3 years; presented as described sample never forecast.

nodes.label: Alerts and cross-engine signals
nodes.rationale: signals.js kinds run on a 15-minute beat with remembered signal_state to avoid re-firing on unchanged findings; PORTFOLIO reserved symbol avoids table rebuild; delivery is in-app only.

nodes.label: Attribution (Carino-linked, vs own average)
nodes.rationale: Brinson needs benchmark sector weights no free source provides, so decomposes against the portfolio itself; Carino linking makes parts sum to compounded return exactly.

nodes.label: Briefing (materiality ranking)
nodes.rationale: materiality = 100 x strength x stake x kind weight; reports change not state; read-only; verdict can conclude nothing happened.

nodes.label: Correlation engine (date-joined)
nodes.rationale: Joining on date not position: identical prices correlate 1.0 joined on date but -0.04 by position. Null never 0; average linkage avoids chaining.

nodes.label: Deliberately honest principles
nodes.rationale: Missing data never filled; null rather than guess; beta joined on dates and refuses under 120 bars; precedents are described samples not forecasts; no overall bull/bear verdict.

nodes.label: Statement importer (preview then apply)
nodes.rationale: Nothing writes on first call; ambiguous dates block import; pence suspicion raised against stored bars; unknown tickers flagged, never remapped.

nodes.label: Memory layer (unusual-for-its-own-history)
nodes.rationale: Levels are free everywhere; the value is whether a move is unusual for that instrument by its own standard, which requires kept history.

nodes.label: Performance engine (XIRR vs TWR)
nodes.rationale: IRR solved by bisection not Newton-Raphson because a wrong confident IRR is worse than a refused one; gap between money-weighted and time-weighted is the timing effect; no ledger means no MWR.

nodes.label: Portfolio Analysis (scorecard, attribution, correlation pairs)
nodes.rationale: Five scorecard axes reuse the rebuild pipeline's axes so numbers agree; attribution ranks by actual pull on weighted average; pulls sum to zero.

nodes.label: Rebuild pipeline (what portfolio should exist)
nodes.rationale: rebalance and allocate take current holdings as given; rebuild can notice duplicate funds and propose new ones. Advisory only, no tax modelling, duplicates collapsed before optimising.

nodes.label: Reports (period-ended, table-driven schedule)
nodes.rationale: Reports cover completed periods and schedule is driven by the table so closed-app weeks still generate. Email transport deliberately not built because it cannot be verified in the sandbox.

nodes.label: Portfolio X-ray (look-through floors)
nodes.rationale: Yahoo publishes only top ten holdings, so weights are floors; scaling disclosed weights up to 100% would be fabrication.

nodes.label: R1-02 day-change fix
nodes.rationale: Day change was overstated on up days; corrected to value x pct / (100 + pct) over yesterday's total.

nodes.norm_label: decisions defaulted in the overnight run

nodes.label: Goal engine (R1-04, bootstrapped)
nodes.rationale: Replaced Gaussian POST /goal with invented 100k/7%/15% defaults by a persisted user goal and block bootstrap; refuses under 252 returns.

nodes.label: Decisions D-01..D-15
nodes.rationale: Items needing Hugo's input (Overview placement, currency, no health grade, tax, proxy sector benchmark, revenue geography, factor tilts, advisory-only actions, theme, layout model); each has a recommended default.

nodes.rationale: {available, reason?, asOf, source, basis?, coverage?, data} so empty/thin data returns available:false rather than 500.

nodes.label: Rejected/reshaped components
nodes.rationale: No overall grade, no AI confidence ratings, no broker export, no free-text actions, no sample data.
